"""Abstract base class for all trading strategies."""

from __future__ import annotations

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    import pandas as pd


class BaseStrategy(ABC):
    """Base interface for trading strategies.

    Strategies receive a DataFrame (optionally with indicator columns) and
    produce a ``signal`` column containing only ``1``, ``-1``, or ``0``.
    ``1`` selects long and ``-1`` selects short; ``-1`` is never a sell-only
    instruction to close a long position.

    In ``mode="signal"``, each row specifies a position state: ``1`` long,
    ``-1`` short, ``0`` flat. Repeat the state while it should persist;
    a one-row entry pulse followed by zero exits on the next signal change.
    ``signal_as_position`` has no effect in this mode.

    In ``mode="volume"``, nonzero signals select the position direction.
    Zero closes an existing position when ``signal_as_position=True``;
    with the default ``False``, zero prevents new entries but retains an
    existing position. An opposite nonzero signal closes and reverses it.

    Both modes shift signals by one bar. Signal-driven entries and exits use
    the following bar's open, falling back to close when open is absent.
    Stop-loss and take-profit rules are separate from these signal changes.
    """

    @abstractmethod
    def generate_signals(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Generate trading signals.

        Args:
            df: OHLCV DataFrame (may already contain indicator columns).

        Returns:
            A separate DataFrame with all input rows in their original order,
            identical index and unchanged timestamp/OHLCV columns, plus a
            ``signal`` column. Every signal must be a finite real -1, 0 or 1;
            warm-up rows use zero, never missing values or dropped rows.
            Do not mutate the input. Indicator columns may contain warm-up NaNs.
        """
        ...

    def fit(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:  # noqa: B027
        """Fit/optimize the strategy on training data.

        Default implementation is a no-op. Override in subclasses
        that support parameter optimization or model training.

        Args:
            df: Training OHLCV DataFrame.
        """

    @abstractmethod
    def get_parameters(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return strategy parameter dictionary.

        Returns:
            Dictionary of parameter names to values.
        """
        ...

    def rolling_trace(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        """Describe how a rolling schedule produced these signals, if it did.

        Returns:
            A diagnostic record, or ``None`` when the strategy does not retrain
            or ran with its rolling switch off. This is captured after
            ``generate_signals`` and stored with the run metrics; it is not a
            parameter and must not be searched over.
        """
        return None
requirements: Inherit BaseStrategy. generate_signals(df) returns a new DataFrame without mutating its input, with signal in {-1, 0, 1}. Follow BaseStrategy's mode-dependent position/zero semantics and next-bar timing; -1 means short, never sell-only. Preserve every row, the exact index and timestamp/OHLCV values. Missing signals are rejected on fixtures and actual execution data. Never use future rows or backfill indicators; emit zero until required values are finite.

Expose configurable values as constructor keyword parameters and get_parameters(). YAML strategy.parameters supplies them. Defaults must be finite JSON values. Generated constructors cannot accept backtest_engine or parallel_config; application services stay outside the isolated strategy process.

Read section=research for the required research input and maintained simulation policy, section=configuration for the YAML schema and section=example when a complete starting example is needed. Use list_data_sources for source-specific market settings.

Generated Python must pass the repository Ruff and strict Mypy policy. static_policy lists the enforced import/call restrictions. No network, subprocess, destructive filesystem access, dynamic imports, eval or exec. Generated imports and methods run in bounded Linux containers with no host mounts or external network. Read section=runtime for resource limits, data boundaries and failure recovery. Static checks alone do not provide isolation.

Prefer tradingdev.domain.indicators for technical indicators. Read section=indicators for the installed function catalog, then select indicator by name for its signature, named result fields, implementation and parameter/input checks. Resolve unavailable references before coding; do not guess APIs or tuple orders. Separate first-party tradingdev imports from third-party imports.

Set random_seed at the YAML root, never in backtest. Use tradingdev.domain.randomness.get_random() or get_numpy_rng() inside the constructor, fit or generate_signals; get_seed() supplies a third-party random_state. Do not call these at module import. Global RNGs are not seeded; null uses independent entropy.
lifecycle: save_strategy creates an immutable source/base-config revision. Omit strategy_id for automatic naming; an explicit ID without expected_revision_id means new creation and must not replace an existing strategy. Repairs require the exact expected_revision_id. Use its revision_id for checks and execution; omitted revision_id selects current once per operation. Saving repairs creates a new draft; older validation evidence does not transfer.

validate_strategy runs static, import, Ruff, Mypy and short-fixture signal/config checks. dry_run_strategy requires validated status and repeats the contract on a longer fixture. Inspect diagnostics, signal_analysis and effective_config against the user's request; passing checks is not proof of every natural-language requirement.

Import, construction and signal checks use a supervised worker with a 60-second budget and isolated generated execution. Abnormal exit, timeout or cleanup failure cannot grant passing evidence. Inspect diagnostics and section=runtime to distinguish strategy repairs from missing infrastructure or unverified cleanup.

Execution requires runnable or promoted status. Each execution fixes effective constructor parameters and checks them again; parameter experiments reuse the runnable revision rather than rewriting its source or base validation evidence. Save a revision only when source or base configuration changes.

prepare_comparison captures 1–8 explicitly proposed parameter sets for an ordinary backtest strategy. Include a label and selection rationale for each set. All candidates share strategy revision, research, costs and data; only constructor parameters vary. Every candidate receives synthetic checks before one whole-set confirmation. After approval, runs use one captured dataset with independent engines, strategy instances and random streams. Training-required and walk-forward comparisons are unsupported; use the existing training workflow. Fixed comparison does not authorize adaptive optimization or selection of only successes. Generate the complete report with comparison_job_id so failed, cancelled and unexecuted candidates remain visible.

Each validation, dry run and optimization trial/test starts a fresh run-local random stream. A backtest or walk-forward run shares one stream across constructor and folds. Contexts do not seed arbitrary global or third-party RNGs.

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import numpy as np

from tradingdev.domain import indicators
from tradingdev.domain.strategies.base import BaseStrategy

if TYPE_CHECKING:

class SmaComparisonStrategy(BaseStrategy):
    """Use completed closes and emit long or flat position states."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        fast_period: int = 10,
        slow_period: int = 30,
        buy_and_hold: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        if not 2 <= fast_period < slow_period <= 100000:
            raise ValueError("Require 2 <= fast_period < slow_period <= 100000")
        self._fast_period = fast_period
        self._slow_period = slow_period
        self._buy_and_hold = buy_and_hold

    def generate_signals(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        result = df.copy()
        if self._buy_and_hold:
            result["signal"] = 1
            return result
        fast = indicators.sma(result["close"], self._fast_period)
        slow = indicators.sma(result["close"], self._slow_period)
        ready = np.isfinite(fast) & np.isfinite(slow)
        result["signal"] = 0
        result.loc[ready & (fast > slow), "signal"] = 1
        return result

    def get_parameters(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "fast_period": self._fast_period,
            "slow_period": self._slow_period,
            "buy_and_hold": self._buy_and_hold,
        }

    def __init__(self, period: int = 20, buy_and_hold: bool = False) -> None:
        if isinstance(period, bool) or not isinstance(period, int) or not 2 <= period <= 100000:
            raise ValueError("period must be an integer between 2 and 100000")
        self._period = period
        self._buy_and_hold = buy_and_hold

    def generate_signals(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        result = df.copy()
        if self._buy_and_hold:
            result["signal"] = 1
            return result
        average = indicators.sma(result["close"], self._period)
        closes = result["close"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        averages = average.to_numpy(dtype=float)
        state = 0
        signals: list[int] = []
        for close, mean in zip(closes, averages, strict=True):
            if not (np.isfinite(close) and np.isfinite(mean)):
                state = 0
            elif close > mean:
                state = 1
            elif close < mean:
                state = 0
            signals.append(state)
        result["signal"] = signals
        return result

    def get_parameters(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"period": self._period, "buy_and_hold": self._buy_and_hold}

analysis.summary: 核對原回測performance.json後，確認benchmarks.full已保存台股加權指數（^TWII）買進持有基準，無須新增回測。本報告僅使用原run_id=a68104ccd4234e4193454de4d09cbfb5的full結果及內含基準。20日均線策略區間報酬24.33%，大盤29.01%，落後4.68個百分點；策略最大回撤8.61%，大盤6.66%，策略回撤較大。在這段歷史區間，策略未勝過已保存的大盤持有基準，也未降低最大回撤。

我建議依這個順序：

1. **先和 0050 自身買進持有比較。** 加權指數能回答是否勝過大盤；0050 持有基準則更能分辨落後來自標的差異，還是均線進出場。

2. **檢查短時間內反覆買賣的損失。** 已保存紀錄中，4/19–4/22、6/4–6/5 都是進場後很快退出並虧損。可以檢查是否在均線附近來回觸發，但目前尚不能確定原因。

3. **優先測試一種減少反覆交易的規則。** 例如連續兩天收盤高於均線才買、連續兩天低於才賣。這是尚未驗證的提案，可能減少交易，也可能延後進出場、增加損失。

4. **用更長期間與未參與調整的資料驗證。** 保留原本 20 日規則作對照，同時補齊實際交易成本，檢查改善是否跨期間成立。

如果由我選第一個改法，我會先研究**連續兩天確認**，而不是立刻大量搜尋均線天數。判斷標準也不只看報酬：要同時看最大回撤、交易成本，以及不同期間是否穩定。以上都只是研究建議，尚未新增回測。

draft.title: 0050 單一20日均線研究｜2024上半年至7月1日
draft.current_brief: 研究問題：用單一20日均線交易0050，是否能取得良好報酬並降低相對台股大盤的風險？本次已完成一組固定規則的歷史回測，並核對該次結果內建、已保存的大盤基準。結論：均線策略區間報酬24.33%，加權指數持有基準29.01%，策略落後4.68個百分點；最大回撤8.61%也高於基準6.66%。這段期間策略有獲利，但沒有勝過保存的大盤基準，也沒有降低最大回撤。未執行參數最佳化或任何改善版回測。

entries.title: 研究範圍與最終交易規則
entries.summary: 商品0050.TW；日K；要求期間為台北時間2024-01-01 00:00:00至2024-07-01 23:59:59，含起訖兩端符合時間戳的資料。實際觀測為2024-01-02至2024-07-01，共118根。每日收盤後，以含當根在內最近20根收盤價計算簡單均線SMA20：收盤價高於均線時持有多單，低於均線時賣出並空手，相等時保留原部位。初始空手；前19根暖機；初始或後續缺值均將內部部位與訊號設為空手。相等採浮點直接比較，沒有容忍區間。訊號延後一根日K於開盤執行，缺open欄位才使用close；持續持有不加碼，不做空，未設停損停利。最初雙均線及獨立買進持有比較提案已被後續需求取代，本次僅執行單均線。

entries.title: 模擬假設與執行識別
entries.summary: 初始本金10000報價貨幣；每次依可用資金及成本決定最大可成交數量，可出現小數數量。各成交手續費率0.06%，滑價率0.05%，均為平台模擬設定，非完整台股實際成本；沒有完整計入ETF賣出交易稅、券商最低費用及整股/零股限制。年化採252個觀測交易日的近似假設，無風險利率0，缺日不補零。期末持倉按最後收盤評價，不強制平倉。回測run_id=a68104ccd4234e4193454de4d09cbfb5；scope=full（唯一可用範圍），沒有訓練與樣本外切分。策略revision_id=3997676618ac4fde9ec61b55889e201e。通過程式與合成資料檢查並完成歷史執行，這不等於全部歷史訊號已逐筆人工驗證。

entries.summary: 20日均線策略：區間報酬24.33%，淨評價損益2433.03，最大回撤8.61%，最大回撤金額1029.57，夏普2.91。已平倉5筆，2勝3敗，勝率40%，獲利因子4.42；另有1筆未平倉。已平倉淨利合計1522.88；6/6進場部位至7/1仍未平倉，評價淨利910.15；後者不是實際賣出獲利。手續費合計74.13，滑價嵌入成交價，其獨立金額不可用，不是零。年化報酬59.21%是252日換算，並非已取得一年報酬。附完整離線HTML，含規則、設定、績效、大盤基準、權益與回撤、成交及帳戶紀錄、配對交易、限制與來源證據。

entries.title: 台股大盤比較與核對結果
entries.summary: 原回測performance.json的benchmarks.full已保存台灣加權股價指數^TWII持有基準，status=available，118根日K全數對齊，缺失0。基準是Yahoo價格報酬，不含現金股利；使用相同本金10000、手續費率0.06%、滑價率0.05%、年化252日。大盤區間報酬29.01%，最大回撤6.66%，夏普3.48，淨評價損益2901.05。均線報酬落後4.68個百分點，最大回撤多1.95個百分點；本金10000時少賺468.02。相同費率下，交易次數不同使總成本不同，大盤手續費約6.00。雙方期末皆按收盤評價；比較的是各自最大回撤，不聲稱發生於同一日期。先前曾因只查摘要而誤認沒有基準，已核對原保存資料更正；另提的新增大盤回測方案已取消，未執行。本次分享使用補齊benchmark章節的完整報告，非最初缺少該章節的舊報告。

entries.title: 短期交易觀察與未驗證假說
entries.summary: 已保存交易中，4/19至4/22淨損298.49，4/30至5/3淨損27.92，6/4至6/5淨損118.51；短期內進出是值得檢查的現象，但尚未核實是否因價格在均線附近來回而觸發，也不能直接歸因市場盤整。診斷工具提出交易數偏少及勝率偏低的檢視提示，僅是啟發式門檻，非原因證明或使用者風險限制。兩筆已平倉獲利及未平倉評價支持正收益，勝率單獨不足以評斷優劣。

entries.title: 改善建議（尚未實作或回測）
entries.summary: 優先釐清標的差異與選時效果：評估0050自身買進持有基準，再判斷20日均線的增益。檢查短期虧損交易的訊號與均線位置。第一個候選改法為連續兩天收盤高於均線才買、連續兩天低於才賣，以嘗試降低反覆交易；其相等與訊號中斷時的計數規則尚待明確定義。這個改法尚未驗證，可能延後進出場並增加損失。保留原20日規則作對照，避免立刻大量搜尋均線天數。後續須用更長期間與未參與調整的樣本外資料，綜合報酬、回撤、成本及跨期間一致性評估。這些是研究提案，不是已證實改善，也未獲授權新增回測。

entries.title: 解讀限制
entries.summary: 半年118根日K及5筆已平倉交易不足以推論長期穩健性；沒有樣本外檢驗或市場狀態分析。加權指數是理論持有基準，不能直接交易；其價格報酬不含股息，0050歷史價格的分割與股息還原處理未獨立核實。標的、進場與暖機時點不同，落後幅度不能直接視為純選時效果或beta調整後alpha。資料來自Yahoo，觀測有覆蓋不等於已獨立驗證資料正確性。模擬成本與數量限制和實務有差異。本摘要為可編輯的研究整理，原報告及保存結果提供執行證據；後續提案不改寫既有執行事實。
